text:
ana: Quick one  customer ran the README quickstart after SSO invite. First chat call returned 200, then embeddings returned 401 with reason org.billing_consent_required. They were confused because the console shows trial active.

ryan: That SSO race again. Chat is allowed via sandbox path, embeddings hit the billing gate. Did the API response include a help_url?

ana: No help_url in the body. Curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":["hi"]}'
```

kevin: If there's no help_url the SDK has to guess. Current Node SDK treats 401 as retryable which makes the quickstart appear flaky (app retries and shows spinner). We should special-case 401 when body.reason starts with "org.billing_" and surface a clear error with console link.

support_bot: Workaround given: ask the workspace owner to accept billing consent at https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing. I opened TKT-8210 and attached logs.

ryan: Two action items: 1) API team to include help_url for onboarding-related errors (so SDKs don't need heuristics). 2) SDK change to treat 401/402 with reason org.billing_* as non-retriable and raise a BillingRequiredError that exposes help_url. I'll file SDK PRs (node + python).

ana: Customer accepted billing and unblocked. Leaving a quick doc note in the onboarding runbook: add a troubleshooting bullet "If chat works but embeddings fail, check workspace billing/consent."

devex-bot: Tagged @sdk-team and @support. Closing thread after SDK ticket created (#INT-5012).

ryan: Adding a small quickstart preflight in the sample app to call /v1/onboarding/status and show a banner if billing not ready. Low-risk UX win.

kevin: I'll own the SDK PR and add unit tests to ensure we don't retry and that BillingRequiredError includes help_url. ETA 48h.

ana: Thanks all :thumbsup:
